key_insight: c0PPO improves value estimation for multi-step reasoning by letting the critic compare intermediate states against verified successful and failed rollouts from the same prompt, rather than judging from state alone.
engineering_relevance: For RLVR systems, this can yield better credit assignment and more stable training while keeping the policy update and deployment interface unchanged.
method: Reuse same-prompt verified rollouts as contrastive evidence for the critic.
Train a self-privileged critic to judge progress toward correct solutions more reliably.
Preserve standard actor-critic optimization while using a smaller asymmetric critic if needed.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent value-estimation gains and better performance than representative actor-critic and critic-free RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
watch_item: Performance depends on access to verified same-prompt rollouts, so data collection and rollout verification cost may limit practicality.
paper_title: Privy to the Foil: Recasting Value Estimation with a Self-Privileged Critic for RLVR
